title: A Vector for the Terminal
author: A. M. Galloway
blurb: Rosalind Coldharbour, an insurance investigator of impossible accidents, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it before Earth's last transmission loop ends.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
